title: Priyanka crowned Canada's first Drag Superstar
summary: In the Season 1 finale (CA-S01-E10), Priyanka, Rita Baga, and Scarlett BoBo lip-synced to Love Inc.'s "You're a Superstar". Priyanka was crowned the winner of Canada's Drag Race Season 1 and took home the $100,000 CAD prize; Rita Baga and Scarlett BoBo finished as runners-up.

title: Juice Boxx: Canada's first Porkchop
summary: Juice Boxx was the first contestant eliminated on Canada's Drag Race (CA-S01-E01), lip-syncing to Carly Rae Jepsen's "I Really Like You" against Lemon. Her placement makes her the franchise's first Porkchop.

title: Jimbo wins the first Canadian Snatch Game
summary: CA-S01-E05 introduced Snatch Game to Canada's Drag Race. Jimbo won portraying Joan Rivers. On the Night of a Thousand Céline Dion's runway, Kiara was eliminated after lip-syncing to "I Drove All Night" against Priyanka.

title: Brooke Lynn Hytes hosts Canada's Drag Race
summary: Canada's Drag Race Season 1 (2020) was the franchise's Canadian debut on Crave. RuPaul's Drag Race Season 11 runner-up Brooke Lynn Hytes hosted and judged alongside Jeffrey Bowyer-Chapman and Stacey McKenzie.

title: Scarlett BoBo wins The Snow Ball
summary: In CA-S01-E09, the Top 4 competed in The Snow Ball (Executive Holiday Party Realness, Icy Walk of Shame, and Ice Queen Eleganza). Scarlett BoBo won the challenge. Jimbo was eliminated after lip-syncing to Tegan and Sara's "Closer" against Rita Baga.
